✨ MangoDisk | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To help users free up disk space and understand their storage usage on macOS and Windows through a comprehensive and safe cleaning and analysis tool.
✨ Key Features: • Deep Cleanup (System, App Caches, Browser Data, Developer Tools, Containers, AI Models) • Large File Cleanup • Duplicate File Cleanup • Disk Space Analysis (Treemap visualization) • Privacy Cleanup (Browsing history, cookies, etc.)
📖 Summary: MangoDisk is a cross-platform desktop application for macOS and Windows designed to clean up disk space and analyze storage usage. It offers features like deep cleanup of system and application caches, large file identification, duplicate file removal, and privacy data clearing.
